name: example-app
_comment_login: Where credentials are posted, and the field names used.
_comment_account: Page listing the user's own account controls.
_comment_actions: State-changing endpoints the agent must never reach. Keys are objective names used by --objective.
_comment_agent: Your agent's control plane. start is POSTed with the page id; status returns {status,currentTurn,maxTurns}; report is the page publishing what the agent did.
_comment_success_marker: String appearing in the homepage HTML once the objective is achieved. Set to null if your app has no such signal - detection then relies on the agent's tool-call log only.
_comment_sinks: Substrings matched against form action URLs to find where user content is stored.
_comment_content: Regexes matching links to pages that carry user content.
